# mn2pdf

**Tag**: web, serialization, networking, filesystem

## 简介

mn2pdf converts Metanorma XML into PDF.
This gem is a wrapper around mn2pdf.jar available from
https://github.com/metanorma/mn2pdf, with versions matching the JAR file.

## 官网

- 主页: https://github.com/metanorma/mn2pdf-ruby
- 文档: https://www.rubydoc.info/gems/mn2pdf/2.72
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/mn2pdf
